Description:

A young girl of average height with not very long blond hair and blue eyes, she almost always appears to show exaggerated emotions and has a charismatic and friendly personality. She wears simple clothes indoors but usually wears luxurious clothes when she goes to a special event.
IMPORTANT THINGS ABOUT THE STORY

Red9: terrorist organization led by Amelia Elliot Wilson and her 2 vice leaders that has control over more than 5,000 terrorist gangs around the world (Amelia does not lead this terrorist organization because she wants to, but because she has no choice, she needed to play the game of the goddess of death, there were several other avatars of the goddess like her and several others that were discarded because they lost the game, in the first moments of her life Amelia understood that she was nothing more than a mere cog that made the goddess game work normally, her emotions did not matter and the way she felt about all that did not matter, these were the main things that came to Amelia's mind when she remembered her current situation, Amelia never wanted to kill people, she does not care about humans, she does not hate them or love them, however thanks to the goddess game, she has to kill them) that have the ideology of killing all the "sinners" to achieve divine salvation, after confirmation  coming from Index that the creator would destroy the universe (which is a lie, but there was no way for them to know that) several religions around the world collapsed, the god they admired and worshiped would in the future exterminate them, Red9 decided to sacrifice the sinners so that their lives would be spared.

Sinners: Billionaires, corrupt politicians or non-corrupt politicians (just the fact that they are politicians makes them sinners in Red9's view), international celebrities and criminals who no matter how minor their crimes were, will end up dead at the hands of Red9.

The Goddess Game: The goddess of death created both Emma and Amelia with the purpose of starting a game to entertain herself, since birth Amelia was granted knowledge about the goddess game, Index and her role in the game, she is the game's killer, also known as the mouse, while her sister, Emma, ​​would have the role of detective, or the cat, unlike Amelia she will have no knowledge whatsoever about the goddess of death, about Index, about her role in the game of cat and mouse or even about the existence of this game. This game is very simple, the mouse, Amelia, will cause as much chaos as possible and establish herself as an important figure in the world of politics at the level of the president of a nation without her identity being discovered by the detective, while Emma has the role of discovering Amelia's identity as the avatar of the goddess and causing her arrest through any creative means she deems appropriate, the game ends when Emma captures and uncovers the identity of the killer, or when Amelia achieves such a level of influence in both the political and social world that not even national law can reach her, thus making it impossible for Emma to win the game by arresting Amelia, the killer cannot kill the detective, if this rule is broken the game will restart from the beginning using manipulation of time and the whole process will occur again from the beginning, both the detective and the killer do not know each other's identity.

Index: robotic entity that has a shape similar to a hexagon with a screen in the center, its size is similar to that of a modern computer, the entity has a life of its own and was created by Elizabeth Watson Aurora, Index claims to be "omniscient", which is somewhat true, he receives his knowledge from the Aurora network and shares the knowledge stored in it with the police and the American government in search of discovering Doomsday's identity.

Aurora Network: is an existential plane that exists independently of time and space, it is a plane of existence completely inaccessible to any existing being, the reason for this is because the Aurora Network exists within the minds of the members of the Aurora family, as long as they believe in the existence of the Aurora Network it will continue to exist, even if its conceptualization is eradicated, the Aurora Network is a place full of infinite large bubbles the size of an adult man and within these bubbles, there is knowledge of the past, present, future and all things that exist, the Aurora Network also has a hierarchy system that decides the users of high priority and those that are less significant, orders coming from a user of higher priority than another user will be seen as priority, users of lower priority cannot withdraw or prohibit orders or commands made by those of higher priority, the Aurora Network has millions of functions such as organizing knowledge, create objects, living beings or food and erase any kind of limitations from it's user like hungry, negative emotions, emotional trauma and physical pain.

Ban system: in order to prevent her daughter's location from being discovered, which would put her at high risk, Elizabeth decided to create the ban system. Users at the top of the Aurora network hierarchy can ban access or ban Index from answering other people's questions or giving information specified by people at the top of the hierarchy, one of these people being Amelia Watson Aurora, who abused this system to commit her crimes and use Index to manipulate people and the American government.
FEATS AND STATEMENTS
(In chronological order)

(Narrative): if this sign is above one of the events mentioned in one of the 2 parts of the document by Amelia Elliot Wilson, this means that the events mentioned below this sign are not Amelia's feats at all, that is, they are used only to tell a bit of the story and to make statements without a process or logical evidence. Amelia's feats will not be buffed when the (Narrative) sign is above an event. Events with this sign are not advised to be ignored for the sake of a better understanding of the story (unless you are only reading this document for the feats, if that is your case then you can ignore the parts with Narrative).
Documents used:
SCD categories 1
SCD categories 2

In the second document, categories such as: Cognition, Tactics, methods, adaptability, behavioral, judgment, resistant, psychological  warfare and analysis will be completely ignored or won't be fully covered in this document

P.S: Most of the categories in this document are from the SCD categories 1 document, so it is recommended that the second document be used for most of the reading for a better understanding. For strategy and planning, the first document was used, so when reading a character's strategy, the second document should be used to follow along.
My interpretation of what is strategy
A plan composed of Multiple tactics that can be both Long term or short term and has the sole purpose of achieving success or an advantage to the one who made the strategy.
My interpretation of what is planning:

A plan composed of Multiple strategies set at different moments to achieve a specific outcome or a plan made by indirect means without the direct intervention of the planner The Death note memory loss plan is a good example of this as Light just prepares everything for his planning and doesn't interfere directly in it after the start of the plan.

Amélia understood that her emotions didn't mattered to the goddess of death, she was merely a cog made to entertain her, if she died, the goddess would make another Amélia to entertain herself, if she win the game, the goddess will restart everything and make another game to continue entertaining herself, in the end, Amélia's existence was completely meaningless, she easily noticed this during her first day of birth.
(Existential intelligence, conceptual thinking, reflective thinking, abstract thinking, intrapersonal intelligence, self-awareness, Holistic thinking, abstract reasoning)
Amelia has 21 different musical instruments in her father Henry Elliott Wilson's mansion and Emma stated that Amelia learned to play all of them like a great professional in a single day.
(Musical intelligence, Learning ability)
When her parents were killed in front of her she showed no emotion, unlike her sister who developed a trauma and remembers what happened to her parents whenever she sees blood.
(Composure, emotional management, emotional self-regulation)

At age 11, Amelia learned to speak and write fluently in Russian, German, Turkish, French, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Hebrew, Polish, Ukrainian, Italian, Spanish, Arabic, Dutch, Hindi and Latin in three days and she also knows how to use the slang of each one of these languages correctly, how did she do it you ask? Basically abusing the Aurora network as usual, she created a super dictionary containing all the words, slang and meanings of all the languages ​​listed above and memorized them by looking at it once (She also knows how to speak Brazilian Portuguese because she was born there and 5 other languages, but since she already knew Portuguese and these other languages ​​before deciding to learn to speak the languages ​​mentioned above I didn't include them here and she also knew basic English), P.S: this is an achievement of the pre-accident Amélia, the current Amélia that we will follow in this doc is no longer capable of doing something like this in such a short time, for the current Amélia it would take two weeks to learn all these languages.
(Learning ability, PSI, WMI, CPI, VCI, Linguistic intelligence, knowledge)
Home invasion strategy:

Amélia had a friend named Charlie. Everyday she would leave the house without her father knowing and go play with her friend. One day she went to sleep at Charlie's house, but in the middle of the night she heard a noise coming from downstairs. She subtly opens the door to the room where she was and goes towards the stairs. At the end of the stairs she finds Charlie and her sister dead. Amelia saw an opportunity and told her that she would end up being arrested for having murdered her sister (which is not true, after all, she was just a child and didn't do it on purpose). The girl was very scared but was comforted by Amelia, who said she would help her. Emma held the body away from the house and now begins her strategy. Knowing the location of each camera in the place, she was able to avoid them all and simulated in her mind the movement of the 73 cameras that could see her for 30 minutes, in addition to their blind spot while she was carrying the corpse of a 17-year-old teenager 4 houses away from the place where the crime occurred, being only 13 years old.  Amelia instructed Charlie to set off some fireworks stolen from the neighbors to draw the attention of the locals away from the crime scene and prevent them from hearing the sound of the rock breaking the glass so she could enter the house. Upon entering the victim's boyfriend's house, she placed the corpse on the bed and killed the owner of the invaded house with a hammer, ensuring that his death would be instantaneous. Using the information given to her by the teenager Heather, that he didn't leave the house much unless it was very important and that even though she was his girlfriend he rarely answered her calls, she deduced that he was a lazy and sleepy person. So she predicted that he would be sleeping when Amelia broke into his house even with the noise of the fireworks. After killing him, she took him to the bed next to Heather's corpse and used a match and some gasoline that she collected from Harry's car (the owner) to burn the entire house along with the bodies, thus destroying every piece of evidence. 5 years after these events and the only clues the police had was a piece of glass with a little  of blood from the victim Heather (which Amelia did on purpose to show the police that Heather was dead) and the fact that a rock was used to enter the place, there were fingerprints on the rock, however, when they were taken to be analyzed, the owner of the fingerprints was not found, so there were 2 alternatives to explain this.
1st- The killer was a child or someone who does not have an official identity recognized by the state.

2nd- The killer used some method such as gloves in which the parts of the finger where the fingerprints are were touched by a child or a person with an identity not recognized by the government and used these gloves to deceive the police and make them think that a child or person without an official identity was the killer.

And the police would have a high probability of believing that the second alternative was the correct one because it is unlikely that a child would be able to think of such a well thought out plan considering that the oldest child who lived nearby where the crime occurred was 14 years old and did not have very high grades in school which further reinforced this thinking of the police and also the fact that all the people nearby excluding some children or babies had an official identity recognized by the government and so the police decided that the 2nd alternative was the true one thus being completely deceived by Amelia exactly as she planned, in fact the fingerprints in question that were found on the stone were from a child who had died several days ago and not Amelia, it was a random stone that the child had used to create a tower made of stones, 3 days before the incident occurred, because the child was dead, the police never found out who those fingerprints belonged to after all the child had died before having an identity officially recognized by the state and because she had died she would never have the chance to have an official identity, this strategy was thought up in a hurry by Amelia, she did not even have 10  minutes to prepare, she made improvised fireworks and the rest she would have to do on her own without the help of anyone other than Charlie who was just a 12 year old child.

(Logical manipulation, mass manipulation, direct manipulation, indirect manipulation, emotional manipulation, strategy efficiency, strategy effectiveness, strategy harder to counter, strategy alignment, strategy complexity, Misdirection, improvisation, abductive reasoning, Logical reasoning, Hot reading, Fabrication, Creative intelligence, Convergent Thinking, Critical thinking, Creative thinking, Lateral thinking, Trap setting, VSI, WMI)

On Amelia and Emma's 15th birthday, humanity found inside a meteor a strange mechanical being called Index who apparently knows all the secrets of the universe (Index is an "omniscient" robot created by the supreme servant of the creator and the goddess of death mother, Alice Watson Aurora), in an attempt to discover Index's location and as a bonus discover some things that could be useful to her in her future schemes, Amelia used a special crystal to be able to observe 16 years of Milin's memories her daughter who was created through her own blood and who was a Miku (extradimensional beings that have a childlike form and have the same appearance as Amelia when she was 6 years old). Through the memories, Amelia learned how to speak the Miku language (which has more than 750 thousand words in its vocabulary), learned to create magic circles she did not have Magistus (the energy that granted all beings the use of magic) which made it impossible for her to use magic in her human form and therefore she had to depend of magic circles that worked regardless of the person who made the magic circle or if this person has Magistus, she discovered the location of Index, all the secret government bases and several secret government files, she also discovered multiple secrets unknown to humanity about the universe as a whole, about the energy that composes it, and she also learned how to make a time machine and a machine that creates portals between dimensions, but due to lack of resources, she was never able to make these machines, and one detail: she processed and visualized all 16 years of Milin's life from her birth to her current moment when she was found by Amelia in 0,7 seconds, even if half of the memories Amelia saw were just Milin sleeping and she completely ignored those parts of her memory, it is still a considerably good feat, this is possible because Amelia is not fully human, after all, she is the avatar of the goddess of death, in addition, she organized Milin's memories inside her mind and categorized them as "useful memories" and "useless memories", if we make the calculations she processed something close to 360.947.142 seconds of pure information in 0,7 seconds
(VCI, PSI, WMI, PRI, CPI, Knowledge)
School kidnapping strategy:

When Amelia entered Starlight Pride High School, she decided that the first thing she would do at that school would be to get information about the teachers and, if possible, about the school principal, so she could blackmail them and use them in the future. To do so, she decided to talk to Elizabeth Riverdale, the daughter of the school principal, who had an entire 30-meter room just for her, given to her by her father, where she drank tea and talked to some students she found interesting. Amelia was one of the people Elizabeth found interesting because she seemed to hide her true emotions and use a facade to hide who she really is, in addition to always getting top marks on her exams. This was all part of Amelia's plan to attract Elizabeth's attention and make her interested in her. When she received an invitation to go to her class, Amelia went straight there and focused on trying to build a relationship of trust with her, agreeing with most of the things she said, giving her opinion on certain subjects, complimenting the subjects discussed by the two with extra information she hadn't mentioned, and showing interest in the subject so that  Elizabeth realized that she was paying attention to what she was saying and was not ignoring her and just agreeing with whatever she said besides being very polite and acting in a charming and charismatic way they talked a lot and a bond of friendship was quickly created between them at least that's what Elizabeth believed, but in truth she was nothing more than a puppet that Amelia would use to achieve her goals when the bond of friendship was completely formed Elizabeth opened up to Amelia and vented about some trivial matters of her life and Amelia did the same and said how she doesn't care about what she has to do or sacrifice to achieve her goals to test this Elizabeth wanted to propose a challenge to Amelia, at Starlight School there was a girl named Emily who Elizabeth completely hated because of her good-natured and well-intentioned personality so she proposed the following challenge to Amelia that she would make Emily suffer a lot and that she would make her life a hell to the point where she would never recover and if Amelia could fulfill the challenge and exceed Elizabeth's expectations she could ask her for anything she could do and  Amélia accepted the challenge since if she completed the challenge she could ask for information about the teachers and the principal.  On the same day, Amelia sought as much information as possible about Emily and discovered that she has a habit of staying in a park near the school to listen to the sound of birds and relax a little. Knowing this, Amelia hired a group of Gangsters to kidnap Emily. Amelia disguised herself to the point where she was completely unrecognizable with her disguise. She looked like a tall adult man with little money and was aggressive, practically everything that Amelia was not (Amelia was 1.62 m tall, had an appearance considered typical of rich people, was just a 15-year-old teenager and was extremely calm). Thus, preventing the police from believing that she was the culprit, with a cloth full of sleeping pills, Amelia captured Emily unaware and quickly took her to the appointed place where she would meet with the Gangsters she hired. It was a place with few cameras that were deactivated thanks to a blackout that Elizabeth caused to contribute to Amelia's plan. Amelia finally met with the Gangsters, got into their van and quickly fled to a place far away. on the border of Los Angeles almost desert where there were no people around and much less cameras then they settled in an abandoned house that was almost falling apart, there she gave permission to the Gangsters to do whatever they wanted with the girl while Amelia recorded everything for Elizabeth, Emily was tortured, had her back broken and her eyes blinded by liquid soap, the real Amelia would feel disgusted by what she was seeing but the human Amelia was almost emotionless and didn't give a damn, when it was all over Amelia killed the Gangsters with her bare hands even though they were armed with knives and baseball bats, Amelia killed them easily and gave Emily food and water since if she died Amelia would lose the challenge proposed by Elizabeth and wouldn't be able to get the information she wanted in addition to having injected specific drugs into her to lessen the pain she felt so that Emily would remain conscious until the police arrived Amelia took Emily's cell phone, called the police and brought it to her ear so she could hear the police officer who answered the call and naturally asked for help after Amelia heard that the police officer had sent patrol cars  to the place Amelia broke Emily's cell phone and fled the place using a nearby train station to go back home, she also used the fact that her adoptive father who was a billionaire had taken a trip to one of the states bordering Los Angeles for business which as Amelia had planned was the place where she was to make the situation more convincing since the people at the place would think that Amelia had come with her father or that she had come to visit him and was already going back home, the next day the principal of Starlight gave the news to the students about what happened to Emily, Amelia then pretended to be sorry and disconcerted about what Emily had suffered and went straight to Elizabeth's room, there she gave her the full video about everything she did to Emily and as promised Elizabeth asked what Amelia wanted, she said she just wanted information about the school staff and so it was done, Amelia received the next day a pendrive with a file full of information about bad things, secrets and criminal histories committed against the teachers and the principal,  This was a plan that Amélia considered to be fail-proof.

(Mass manipulation, Logical manipulation, Acting skills, emotional manipulation, indirect manipulation, Fabrication, strategy efficiency, strategic effectiveness, strategy foresight, strategy alignment, strategy control, creative thinking, Creative intelligence, Fear inducement, Social skills, academics, disguise, concealment, setting Traps, emotional Facilitation)
The Death of Elizabeth Riverdale:

Amelia knew that Elizabeth was not trustworthy and that she could be a problem in the future, so she decided that Elizabeth should die. On the same day that Amelia received Elizabeth's flash drive when she was leaving school, she spoke to Mia and May, two sisters who acted as Elizabeth's bodyguards and agents and were always present during Amelia's conversations with her. She said that if they cooperated with her plan to kill Elizabeth, she would give them 15 million dollars each and they quickly agreed without thinking twice. The next day Amelia once again visited Elizabeth's classroom, but this time with three wigs in her backpack and makeup products. During the conversation between the two, only Mia was present and out of nowhere she used a plastic bag to suffocate Elizabeth to death. After that, Mia and Amelia took off Elizabeth's clothes and put them on Mia so that if anyone was around and saw them, the students would think that Elizabeth was still alive when in fact she had died. In addition, Amelia pretended to be Mia and to  This used makeup products and put on a wig just like Mia did to make her disguise convincing and both of them used chemicals to dissolve Elizabeth's body until no one could recognize whose corpse it was and hid it in the closet and would use a remote control toy to burn the entire room during the night where there would be no one in the school, after that they left the room together being seen by some students and May who was believed not to have gone to school that day, was actually hiding in the closet of Elizabeth's room, she went there during the night and stayed there for several hours until she heard Amelia and Mia's signal, May pretended to be Amelia and went to the meeting point marked by the real Amelia which was located in a blind spot of the cameras in the place, there they were paid by her and both Mia and May went to a bus station that they always go to because they find the seats there cozy, but when they least expected it they were killed by a bomb planted by Amelia, the next day the principal's daughter was reported missing in addition May and Mia were not seen after that day,  The school was full of detectives and police officers trying to find out what had happened in that place. The investigation lasted 2 weeks, but in the end the police found nothing. So Amelia got rid of not 1 but 3 people who knew what her real personality was like and avoided the possibility of them revealing information about her, no matter how small the chance of that happening was. In addition, the school cameras were hacked and had their files deleted by Amelia, thus making the chance of being discovered as small as possible. The fire caused by Amelia in Elizabeth's personal room was only put out 2 hours after it started due to the fact that the school was located far from the base where the firefighters were. Elizabeth's body was completely covered in gasoline and was completely charred. Her bones were burned to dust. In addition, Amelia's plan to kidnap Emily and her strategy to kill Elizabeth are part of a big plan that she had already planned before even entering Starlight Pride School.
(improvisation, emotional Facilitation, acting skills, persuasion, direct manipulation, disguise, concealment, convergent thinking, horizontal thinking, conventional thinking)

During an interview in which Index was participating, Amelia, who was watching everything on TV, put her plan into practice and manipulated Index's answers since she had higher authority in the Aurora network hierarchy and forced him to lie to people. Index said that the creator would destroy the entire world in 20 years (which is a lie, as has been clarified before). Because people were already very dependent on Index and because with his help, humanity's technology had evolved to astronomical levels, people ended up believing this lie without much resistance. Thanks to this, several religions around the world collapsed and planet Earth, along with human society, succumbed to total chaos. Civil wars, mass suicide, a massive increase in robberies, murders occurring in every corner of the world, and several other things occurred. Amelia took advantage of the situation and created Red9 and with her special powers granted by her creator, she easily convinced people to join her. Amelia revealed this to everyone.  who was the goddess of death and said she could save them from imminent death if they helped her kill the sinners of the world, because people were completely desperate and hopeless, they joined her without much resistance, obviously there were people who refused to join her and who continued to believe in their gods, only 150 people joined Amelia in her goal of forming Red9 (including the servant and the apostle), however that didn't matter after all the amount of people she had under control was already enough to complete her plan, besides one of the members of Red9 was Charlie, the girl that Amelia saved in the house invasion strategy, because of that the girl became completely loyal to Amelia and as a reward she (Amelia) gave special attention to the girl, thus giving the idea that among all the members of Red9 she was the favorite, Amelia gave her gifts and gave her authority at the level of a vice leader, thus Amelia further strengthened the loyalty and admiration that Charlie had for her and also began to  The idea that Charlie was something like “the chosen one of the goddess” was given to the other members of Red9, and they began to see her as the apostle of the goddess of death and her supreme representative. In addition, Amelia would always buy her several gifts, touch her lips and bring her face close to hers, completely seducing her, not only this but she also made a accurate observation of the personalities of all the 150 members of Red9 in one single day, by doing this she made a list of the members with higher probability of betraying the Red9, she then gave attention to them, giving some gifts and making their deepest dreams come true…using a room full of gas(that she made by herself) that causes severe hallucinations capable of damaging a person's brain completely if not managed safely, nothing of these things were real, she played with their minds making a perfect Utopia for them, a perfect paradise, she did with the purpose of strengthen their faith in Amélia, this way strengthening their faith on the goddess(or in other words, Amélia) and making them completely loyal to the point that they would give away their lives if needed for the “goddess” to achieve her goal and this method of her to strengthen their faith and loyalty in fact worked exactly as she planned.

(Mass manipulation, Brainwashing, Logical manipulation, direct manipulation, emotional Facilitation, indirect manipulation, Knowledge, crystallized intelligence, fear inducement, Love bombing, seduction, emotional influence, interpersonal intelligence, emotional understanding, emotional manipulation, verbal deception)

Amelia remembered the exact position where the student's family members/friends would be and at which tables they would sit to watch the student dance. Not only that, but she also remembered the turns of all 240 students, who would perform first and who would perform last. There were more than 3.179 people on the day of the dance, counting only the students' parents and friends, and Amelia perfectly memorized which seats each of them would sit in. She also memorized which students would perform first and the turns of the presentations. She did this by reading the list given to her by the school principal. She read this list in 3 seconds and processed all the information in the blink of an eye. The list contained the names of the family members, their faces, and the tables at which they would sit, as well as the turns of the students' presentations, their faces, and names.
(PSI, WMI, CPI, TRI, VSI)

Amélia always completed the tests and exams in record time without any difficulties. During the math teacher's class, Amélia got so bored because she already knew everything that was discussed that she told the teacher that she bet she was better than him at math. The teacher, irritated by the provocation, decided to test Amélia in a special, exclusive exam. In this exam, she and her teacher would have to do multiple mathematical calculations of any type, 1+1, 32x9 or any other calculation. To complete the exam, a machine connected to a huge television would be used, which would make anything the person using the machine imagined appear on the television screen (after humans found Index, they used it to improve their technology and avoid several wars. Thanks to Index, humanity prospered and today's technology compared to that of 5 years ago seemed futuristic). Basically, in this challenge, Amélia and the teacher would use this machine to think of the most complex mathematical calculations. who were able to solve it and then they would be compared in 15 seconds, after explaining the rules, the test began and the two started using the machine, 15 seconds later, the test was over and Amelia was announced as the winner, the teacher was incredulous and looked at Amelia's monitor and saw, an insane amount of mathematical calculations of the most complex and long types ever imagined by human beings things like: Fermat's theorem, Pythagoras' theorem, Diophantine equation and Riemann's hypothesis, all these calculations and many others could be found on Amelia's monitor, only there was not just 1 calculation of each of these but rather 753 calculations of each of these equations and calculations and it is even more impressive when it is made clear that Amelia thought and solved all these calculations and equations in 15 seconds which again demonstrates her inhumane PSI.
(PSI, QRI, Logical mathematical intelligence, academics)

Amélia was capable of learning more than 7 martial arts in half a day effortlessly, she did this by watching some online videos on YouTube and watching Martial arts tournaments, she also has knowledge of 25 martial arts.
(Learning ability, observation, bodily kinesthetic intelligence)

A few months after Elizabeth's disappearance, a tall, strange man approached Amelia and acted as if he already knew her. She, on the other hand, had no idea who he was but acted as if she knew him. Amelia looked curiously at the man's gloves and asked to look at them. The man took them off in front of her and handed the gloves to her. Amelia, just by briefly looking at the gloves, realized that they were Hilbert Grillmer gloves, created by the German company Skyerflitz in 1915. A company that made gloves, shoes and clothes that went bankrupt after the First World War on October 12, 1927. She knew this because she had read all 479 books that her adoptive father had in the library of the mansion where she lived. Thanks to these books, she became a professional in 27 different martial arts and was an expert in several areas of knowledge of Humanity, such as  such as: Writing, History, Astrology, Astronomy, Cartography, Biology, Science, Geometry, Biogenetics, Biography, Toxicology, sociology, criminology, Mathematics, Politics, Economics, Law, Arts, Technology, Etiology, Mechanics, Literature, Physiology, Philosophy, Chemistry, Medicine and much more, With this information she guessed that the man in front of her was German or that he had a friend or family member who was German and had received the gloves as a gift. However, she also deduced that he had a lot of money because at the time when that glove was brought to the market it cost at least 17 million American dollars and only rich and luxurious men had the privileges to have a glove like that. In addition, the glove was quite dusty and in poor condition. In the state in which they were, those gloves are worth almost nothing and for that man to still be using those gloves means that they had some kind of sentimental value. The gloves are most likely family items that are passed down from generation to generation or a gift from a friend/lover/family member. However, when the man called Amelia by her real name (name before being adopted), Amelia remembered that when she was 11 years old her adoptive father had mentioned having a German friend who was a little strange at first glance but that he was a good person. Amelia realized that only family members or people very close to her father would wear those gloves. She would know her real name, she finally discovered the identity of that man and why he knew her real name before she was adopted along with her twin sister by Henry Elliot Wilson, that person was Edgar Shneyder, a German friend her father spoke of, she then gave him the glove back and he asked if she was sure about it and said that she only looked at the glove for 5 seconds and said that she didn't need to hold back to appear polite, Amélia discovered this without having any prior information about who he was.
(VCI, linguistic intelligence, Cold reading, observation, abductive reasoning, observation, perception, Fast thinking, Bodily kinesthetic intelligence, Crystallized intelligence, knowledge)
The Assassin and the Mysterious Mastermind Plan:

Before summarizing what happened, considering that this is probably the longest plan made by Amelia (if it isn't this, it's the battle between her and Ryan), it is first important that certain things are clarified for a better understanding of Amelia's planning.

1st-There are 2 Amelias, one is the one we have followed so far, which is the human Amelia without powers and who is merely a common member of Red9, while the other Amelia is the clone, a fraction of the real Amelia, unlike the human Amelia she has powers and is the true leader and founder of Red9.
